About Me

Passionate about Robotics & Intelligent Systems

I am a Robotics and Automation engineering student at Rajarambapu Institute of Technology, affiliated to Shivaji University. With a keen interest in robotic system design, I am passionate about exploring automation, intelligent systems, and the applications of AI in robotics.

Beyond academics, I have published research on AI in Swarm Robotics, represented Maharashtra at the National Youth Festival 2026, led the RIT IEEE Student Branch as Chair, and headed the Space Club — launching sounding rockets to over 1km apogee.

Portfolio

Projects

A selection of engineering projects spanning rocketry, robotics, and sustainable systems.

Project 01 — Space Club · RIT
CanSat & Sounding Rocket — DHRUVA

As Satellite Head of RIT Space Club, led the design and launch of the DHRUVA sounding rocket to apogees of 700m and 1km. The rocket carried a CanSat payload integrated with an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and a real-time pollution detection system for atmospheric data collection. Successfully launched with full telemetry and recovery via parachute.

IMU Sensor Pollution Detection Parachute Recovery Telemetry 3D Printing
Project 02 — Robotics Lab
Maze Solver / Obstacle Avoidance Robot

Designed and implemented an autonomous robot using an Arduino microcontroller equipped with ultrasonic sensors (HC-SR04) for real-time obstacle detection and avoidance. The robot navigates unknown environments using sensor-based decision algorithms, capable of solving mazes and dynamically rerouting around obstacles.

Arduino Ultrasonic Sensors Servo Motor C++ Autonomous Navigation

Line Follower Robot

Autonomous robot using Arduino & IR sensors for line detection, enabling accurate path tracking and smooth movement.

Energy from Plastic

Controlled combustion setup converting plastic waste to usable energy with integrated air filtration to reduce toxic emissions.

Autonomous Detergent Vending Machine

In association with LINA Detergent Co. — automated vending system dispensing detergent based on customer demand.
